Run: L12's operands case changed to 1,777 items of 1,100 bytes (1,999,852 bytes, 148 under the cap) gave no answer and one owed Cmd; restored. Second, L2's mix tamper always inserts a stranger chunk, so the seq check alone catches it: a plant that drops join's id check stayed green. Not blocking: a later mail can overtake an earlier plain send owed after a storage failure (pre-existing; widening the wait to plain sends turns the existing M2 alarm law red, so it needs its own design call); RunnerOptions.chunk keeps a second copy of mail.chunk's default; the plan step's run row is missing. Plants run on product code and restored: the cap reading head in place of end (L6 red), no ack at a turn's start (L10 red), the acked read scanning the whole stream (L7 red), join without the id check (L2 green, the second blocker), and the wait behind any owed send (M2 red). loosening.sh: every hit read, none a loosening.
